author: Kat P
text: Without hesitation, they came out on a Saturday to remove the debris and blockage in my basement main drain, which prohibited me from washing my clothes. I am so thankful that they showed up today. And they include a warranty!!! Excellent people!

author: Dena Mooty
text: Lenny, Gabrielle, and Jean-Luc are a stellar team.  They were responsive, arrived on time and helped us investigate the water issue. We needed to scope multiple lines to determine next steps. They were thorough and continued to provide education on the process.  They informed us at each step.  We’re grateful and can now make informed decisions!  Lenny and the Sewer Technology team are trusted expert professionals.  Our experience was great.  Should we have a similar need in the future on another property, we know who to call - Sewer Technology.
